item.text: {"verdicts":[{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0013-E001","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0013-E002","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0013-E003","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0013-E004","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0013-E005","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"The analysis said that review and renegotiation of cobalt and copper mining deals between China and the DRC showed how the DRC government could increase its negotiating agency; it warned that the December 2023 election could create risks of political interference and conflicts of interest, and recommended technical expertise, cost-benefit analysis, clear benchmarks and oversight for MOU execution.","notes":["The excerpt does not itself explicitly state that the DRC government was conducting the review and renegotiation; it refers to the review and renegotiation and then discusses how the government could increase its agency."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0013-E006","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0013-E007","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0013-E008","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0013-E009","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"CENI announced that 44 million people were registered to vote but did not provide the voter register for review and verification; it reportedly declined AU and UN offers to audit the electoral roll, had the figures reviewed over five days, and rejected calls for an independent audit.","notes":["The excerpt says CENI had reportedly declined the AU and UN offers, so the attribution is narrowed accordingly.","The excerpt says an auditor reviewed the figures over five days; it does not explicitly call this an internal audit in the supplied English passage."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0013-E010","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0013-E011","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"Voting did not occur in Rutshuru and Masisi amid the resurgence of M23 and other armed groups, disenfranchising hundreds of thousands of citizens during the 2023 elections; the article said this could fuel civil unrest and instability and called for political dialogue, electoral reform and improved security.","notes":["The excerpt states that the resurgence of M23 and armed groups meant voting did not happen; it does not expressly state armed-group control as the sole cause."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0013-E012","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0013-E013","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0013-E014","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0013-E015","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0013-E016","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0013-E017","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"During the first half of 2023, ICRC and DRC Red Cross activities in North Kivu reunited 108 children with their families, organized 82,639 calls for separated relatives, reached 15,722 children through recruitment-prevention activities, provided food or household assistance to many thousands of people, and supported health, water and sanitation services for displaced and host communities.","notes":["The excerpt supports the listed activities but does not support the broader attribution to operations across North and South Kivu; the supplied passage is focused on North Kivu."]}]}
